1_action_network.what: per-book closing lines + PUBLIC BET PERCENTAGES + bet counts, 2020-2026
1_action_network.harvested: 1697 games / 113 weeks (scratch/an_odds/harvest.json), 1253 frozen games matched, 1195 with public%
1_action_network.signal_test: public%-deviation from 50 correlates with residual sd (13.06 -> 12.45 as public piles in) but does NOT improve champion v3 when added to atoms or sigma (7.1375 / 7.1350 vs 7.1346). Interpretation: public position is already priced into the closing vig — the vig-atom channel (champion v3) is the compressed version of this signal.

2_cross_book_dispersion.what: stdev of closing spread across ~7-45 books per game — direct market-uncertainty measure
2_cross_book_dispersion.blocker: AN odds[] arrays mix line-movement snapshots; need per-book max(inserted) filter (inserted timestamp exists on every record)
2_cross_book_dispersion.next: re-harvest 2023 with timestamp filter, test dispersion as sigma covariate

3_nflverse_injuries.what: official NFL weekly injury reports 2017-2026 (52138 rows, keyless)
3_nflverse_injuries.signal_test: QB-out games raw residual sd 13.08 vs 12.74 baseline — real but already priced into spread_line; adding to champion atoms or sigma made it worse (7.1367/7.1368 vs 7.1346)

4_nflverse_pbp_epa.what: rolling EPA diff drives the 3/7 atom masses — the -0.0024 that beat the mixture

KNOWN_BUT_LIMITED.scoresandodds_market_comparison: AWS execute-api, keyless, current-day only, needs live event ids
KNOWN_BUT_LIMITED.oddstrader_graphql: schema fully mapped, history endpoints empty on free tier (live-window only)
KNOWN_BUT_LIMITED.covers/vegasinsider/sbr: HTML-only, no better data than the APIs above

champion_status.honest_read: public data is largely exhausted for the sigma/atom framework. The remaining ~0.036 to the gate requires either multi-timestamp closing lines (paid), sharp/public DOLLAR splits (vs bet counts — AN has num_bets but money% fields were null on historical records), or a different forecast target.
